title: Tekla Structures workflows and connector status
description: Explore Tekla Structures workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Tekla Structures

Tekla Structures provides detailed structural modelling for constructible steel and concrete information.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Detail a structural connection

Start from the selected building, infrastructure or plant elements and their current parameters. In the intended Tekla Structures preview, detail a structural connection; the visible result is an updated model view that identifies each affected element. Review levels, connectivity, classification and design intent before accepting or exporting it.

Check member coordination

Begin with the coordinated discipline context and current issue set. In the intended Tekla Structures preview, check member coordination; the visible result is a comparison, check or automation result linked to model objects. Review element identity, clashes, rules and downstream effects before accepting or exporting it.

Prepare fabrication information

Use the accepted model proposal and document set. In the intended Tekla Structures preview, prepare fabrication information; the visible result is updated schedules, drawings or issue information derived from the same subject. Review coordination status, quantities and publication scope before accepting or exporting it.
